text: SEADRIF 2.0 is a World Bank-supported initiative aimed at enhancing financial resilience against natural catastrophes in Southeast Asia. It operates as a regional platform under the ASEAN+3 political umbrella, providing pre-arranged disaster risk financing and insurance solutions. The initiative is anchored in Singapore, with SEADRIF Insurance Company and SEADRIF Trust serving as key operational entities. SEADRIF 2.0 focuses on rapid post-disaster response through parametric insurance and pre-arranged financing, facilitating quick payouts and reducing the financial impact of disasters on member countries.

metadata.solution_name: Southeast Asia Disaster Risk Insurance Facility (SEADRIF) 2.0: Boosting Financial Resilience in Southeast Asia
